Claim 5 (Currently Amended): Use of the composition of claim 1 for preparation of __a blocking vaccine__ to impede and __reduce the incidence of Leishmaniasis transmission in humans or animals__.

Claim 6 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 4 wherein said composition further comprises suitable __carrier__ pharmacological vehicles, for blocking __and reducing the incidence of__ Leishmaniasis transmission in humans or animals.

Claim 7 (Currently Amended): The composition of claim 1, wherein the Leishmania promastigotes or Leishmania amastigotes fractions called "Fucose Mannose Ligand" (FML) comprise a glycoprotein complex containing __specific percentages of neutral sugar, protein, phosphate, and hexosamines, which demonstrate efficacy__ for blocking and impeding __Leishmaniasis transmission in humans__.
